claims: The dredging will be delayed by three weeks because the contracted dredger needs engine repairs.
The delay will mainly affect larger container vessels, which must wait for high tide to enter the port.
Fishing boats and ferries are not affected by the delay.
Some cargo deliveries could arrive later than planned, according to local shipping agents.
The authority expects the dredging works to finish before winter.
